name: Should I call my water company or a plumber for a high bill?

mainEntity.name: Should I call my water company or a plumber for a high bill?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have an unexplained high water bill, you should typically start by performing a basic leak detection test yourself, like the water meter check. If you confirm a leak or suspect one, it's best to call a plumber. Your water company is responsible for the water main up to your property line and the meter itself. A plumber, like Alpha-Plumbing Services, focuses on your home's internal plumbing system and the service line leading from the meter to your house. We can accurately diagnose and repair leaks within your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if you suspect a leak within your property after checking your meter. The water company handles issues up to your meter.
